scope: Native rotation marker in the Dharumanyo and Tsurami travelling-projectile constructors; existing symbol reference updates only.

game.runtimeValidation: Host regression and native source review only; fresh two-client rendering was not certified.

addresses: 0x080053DC..0x080053F0: calls owner-relative allocation with this travelling projectile as owner
0x080055EC..0x0800560C: later ring allocation also uses the travelling projectile
0x080056FC..0x08005878: ring initializer preserves inherited object roll
0x80217218..0x80217250: forwards owner rotation halfwords to child allocation
0x800359BC..0x800359C0: stores incoming roll halfword unchanged at new object+0x18

regression.before: After reproducing the native constructor rotation writes in the fixture, authority checkpoint capture failed because yaw 0x8000 exceeded the old 1023 range.
regression.after: Exact 0x8000 or ordinary 0..1023 is accepted. Both native travelling variants reconstruct the same rotation marker on a follower, and 1024 and 0x8001 remain rejected.

limitations: The helper writes a special rotation marker; this evidence does not establish a universal billboard or camera-facing interpretation for every renderer.
Generated native C and ROM data are not copied into the documentation repository.
ringConsequence: The native ring owner is a travelling projectile with roll0x8000. A reconstruction using the boss root as allocation owner needs to retain that native roll explicitly; the ring initializer does not regenerate it.
